in_sanskrit.name: निष्का
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is not bound, free

in_marathi.name: Nishka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nishka हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nishka is a Sanskrit word derived from the Sanskrit root 'nis' meaning 'to remain'. This name signifies purity, cleanliness, and unadulteratedness. It is a revered name for a girl in Hindu traditions, symbolizing the pure and untouched nature of the soul.
